decisions.evidence: 92 has 0 in every hour 00-14 then normal evening counts (day total 54 vs 91's 196 and ~250 the next day).

decisions.evidence: 92 day totals 74 and 16 (partly already set missing) vs 91 210/210; 92 was 253 on 09-08 and ~190-250 on normal weekends.

decisions.diagnosis: Counts doubled for about two days (all slots even).

decisions.diagnosis: Counts doubled for one day on the old counter while the replacement counter ran alongside.

decisions.diagnosis: Counter malfunctioning before the warning outage of 04-29..05-02: flat profile with no commuter peaks and night counts as high as daytime.

series.name: Bridge Rd westbound (outbound, SW)
series.evidence: All three have the same evening-peak (17:00) outbound profile; 159->337 is a direct tube swap with no gap in level (1585/92 ~0.9-1.0 as 91/92 before); 394/1864 in 2026 is +20% on June 2025, matching Anzac Bridge's +21-31% over the same year, so reads comparably (medium: 11-month gap).

series.name: Bridge Rd eastbound (citybound, NE)
series.evidence: Both have the citybound 08:00 peak profile; 1866 June 2026 is +32% on 92's June 2025, matching Anzac Bridge growth (+21-31%); tube to piezo change and an 11-month gap make this medium.

series.name: Bridge Rd eastbound counted by the westbound-lane counter (contraflow)
series.evidence: In 2026 each counter carries one main direction (394 west, 329 east); 1863 is a ~5/day wrong-way trickle with no counterpart before 2026, so kept separate to keep the main series comparable.

series.name: Bridge Rd westbound counted by the eastbound-lane counter (contraflow)
series.evidence: ~5/day wrong-way trickle on counter 329 at this site, with no counterpart before 2026; kept separate.

series.name: King St eastbound
series.evidence: Counters ran together 2025-10-31..11-21 counting the same bikes (slot-by-slot match, same evening-peak profile); 361 reads ~11% higher than 329 (daily ratio 1.07-1.17), a replacement counter at the same site.

series.name: King St westbound
series.evidence: Overlap 2025-10-31..11-21 shows the same bikes (morning-peak profile, daily ratio 1759/1550 1.01-1.08); switch to the replacement at the start of the overlap.

summary: Bridge Rd (169) was counted by one-direction tubes 2021-2025 (159 then 337 westbound, 179 eastbound) and from May 2026 by two counters each carrying one main direction plus a tiny contraflow direction; the 2026 levels match neighbouring growth so the main directions are joined to the earlier series. King St (548) counter 329's first seven months were doubled (already halved automatically) and it was replaced by 361, which overlapped for three weeks counting the same bikes about 4-11% higher. Fixes are a handful of partial reinstall days, failing-tube days and two short doubled runs (1585 in Jan 2025, 1549 on 2025-11-18).
